summary: Iteration 2 backend testing complete. Added 16 new tests covering /api/auth/session negative paths, all /api/admin/* endpoints (stats/users/solar/loan/contacts/notices/status updates), user_id UUID end-to-end flow, and logout session_token clearing. 39/40 tests pass. The only failure is test_google_auth_stub which is now stale (endpoint /api/auth/google was intentionally removed and replaced with /api/auth/session in this iteration).

minor.issue: Endpoint removed in favor of /api/auth/session (real Emergent OAuth). Stale test test_google_auth_stub still references it and fails with 404. Not a bug — remove the obsolete test or intentional replacement is confirmed.

action_items: Optional: delete or update test_google_auth_stub in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py since /api/auth/google was intentionally removed. Left in place to visibly flag the API surface change.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 555 lines and starting to grow — consider splitting admin routes and seed logic into separate modules if it grows further (>700 lines).

auth.py get_current_user does two DB lookups per request when session_token cookie is present but no matching session (still falls through to JWT). Fine for now, but consider single-shot short-circuit if perf matters.

CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' when FRONTEND_URL env is not set, but allow_credentials=True is unsafe with wildcard origins per CORS spec. Currently OK because FRONTEND_URL is likely set in prod; still worth failing fast if missing.
/api/admin/notices returns notice with 'id' via doc_public but uses ObjectId string — DELETE endpoint validates via ObjectId(). Consistent. Good.

clear_auth_cookies deletes cookies but does not respect samesite=none/secure=true attrs — some browsers refuse to delete cookies unless attrs match. Consider passing samesite='none', secure=True to delete_cookie for consistency (functional cookies did clear in tests via requests, but browsers may keep them).
